rows.text: Outside the city of Icatus, a warrior clad in heavy armor laughs heartily amidst a crowd. He brandishes the weapon in his hand, proclaiming himself kin of Georios.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "This here spear once pierced the chest of a sea monster, that servant of Phagousa with two hearts and nine heads. Were it not for the Titans' blessing upon me, I would never have escaped its maw alive."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Yet the chorus of praise fails to sate his vanity, and a murmur of doubts arises from the crowd. His eyes dart about restlessly, anxiously seeking a challenger to prove his strength. And then, your eyes meet.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: The man winks at you, as if hinting to you to strike a private deal.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Ignore insinuations and engage in a fair duel.
The man shakingly raises his spear, like a startled hedgehog.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Accept the bribe and hold back in the duel.
You pay no heed to the man's request for reinforcements — who says that Georios' blessing can't be "strength in numbers"?
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
